findings.title: Direct LLM API invocations bypassing model router in emergency alert summary

evidence.observation: Direct provider calls 'call_gemini' and 'call_mistral' using os.environ API keys instead of routing through the model router service

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency_alert_summary.py to use the centralized model router endpoint at port 8891 rather than calling third-party provider APIs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model usage, ensures adherence to router policies, and enables observability and call tracking.

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Router status indicates log_file is set to /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl, but call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null despite recent requests recorded (recent_avg_ms: 61679)

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process has write permissions and automatically initializes call_log.jsonl upon startup.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into individual model execution times, task routing patterns, and potential runtime errors.
